state.persona: Matt, 30s, New Yorker, on day 2 of a 6-day Lisbon trip with his partner Sam. Standing on a Lisbon street on his phone (390x844), battery at 12%, wants to decide what to do in the next few minutes without reading much. Loves classic rock and rock bars. Knows nothing about the app internals.
state.job_to_be_done: Find something good to do nearby right now (21:45), because the trip plan's pick doesn't appeal.
state.workflow_state: Tapped 'Something else nearby, right now →' on the trip. Landed on the NOW page (/now?city=Lisbon). Scrolling down on the phone, top to bottom, he sees:
state.visible_text: 1) NOW · LOCAL DECISION ENGINE / Where should we go right now? / Give dope.travel the moment you are actually in. It filters what is viable, reads the local energy, and gives you three decisions instead of another directory. 2) DAY 2 OF 6 · YOU'RE HERE / Right now in Lisbon / NOW · LATE NIGHT — Live music tonight in Lisbon — Search Maps ↗ 3) LATE NIGHT · FOR MATT / More ideas in Lisbon / City [Lisbon] [Show me] / Cocktails in Lisbon ↗ The bar with a story. / Rock cover bands in Lisbon ↗ Because you listen to classic rock, rock. / Each idea opens a live Maps search near Lisbon, shaped by your board. Check it's open before you go. 4) Live music tonight in Lisbon / Rock cover bands … / Event feeds not connected / Rock cover band bar in Lisbon ↗ 5) NOW · NOT CONNECTED YET / NOW can't pick venues tonight. / Live nearby venue search is awaiting its provider, so there are no recommendations to show. OPEN ITS GUIDE [dropdown, no Lisbon in it] / Browse ACCESS samples ↗ · Explore the world calendar ↗ 6) A photo card 'Make tonight worth the story.' then a form (intent, vibe, radius...) whose 'Find my next move' button is disabled, about 4000px down the page.
state.not_shown: No specific venue anywhere; all ideas are Maps searches.
